message: ダンスダンスダンス
A silhouette appears.
Gradually, it grows more distinct.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...」
I step toward the figure. The earpiece I tore from my ear rolls at my feet.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」
I forcibly hold back the urge to break into a run.
The silhouette looks my way.
The moment our eyes met, I couldn't hold back anymore.
I broke into a run and stood right in front of Azel.

name: Synn
message: 「Welcome back.」
Azel turned her face away from me.

name: Azel
message: 「...You're an idiot.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, if we fight, we won't be able to dance.」

name: Azel
message: 「Dance?! You're still going on about that?!」

name: Azel
message: 「You and I are enemies! I'm a weapon of God, and you're the Demon Lord! Fight me!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm Synn Sakura. And Azel is Azel.」
Shooting stars shining in seven colors were cascading down like an avalanche.

name: Azel
message: 「It doesn't work like that! Do you still not know?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I want to know more about you, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「Oh, so you want to know that badly?」
Azel's face twisted into the most wicked expression she could muster--
--or at least that was probably what she was going for, though it wasn't working very well.

name: Azel
message: 「Then I'll tell you. I've been deceiving you all this whole time! You fools were completely played!」

name: Azel
message: 「You didn't even notice that I was using Bylous's gang to advance my plot to destroy this world! What a bunch of idiots!」

name: Azel
message: 「On top of that, I was leaking your information for the magic circle creation plan that Soltia devised and Pasta commanded!」

name: Azel
message: 「Adding someone like me to the Student Council--you're an idiot. An idiot, an idiot, a massive idiot!」
Her voice as she hurled insults at me sounded somehow forced and painful to hear.

name: Azel
message: 「And I cooperated with Soltia's plan in order to eliminate you, since you're an obstacle to Re-Crea!」

name: Azel
message: 「I just stood there watching you get covered in blood! You only survived because you happened to be the Demon Lord!」

name: Azel
message: 「Even now, I didn't appear here because you told me to! I only showed up because it was necessary to destroy the world!」

name: Azel
message: 「Come on, fight me! If you're the Demon Lord, then struggle desperately for all you're worth」
Suddenly, a graceful melody reached my ears. It was from the rehearsal CD.
I instinctively looked toward the wind ensemble club's booth.
Ria-senpai nodded at me.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「Fight! Fight me, Demon Lord! Try defying a god with that puny power of yours!」
I took Azel's hand.
Unlike before, that hand was warm.

name: Azel
message: 「W-What are you doing!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Before the world ends, dance with me」

name: Azel
message: 「You and I dancing, ah...」
When I pulled a little forcefully and began to dance, Azel didn't resist.

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry. All I know how to do is spin around in circles」
Meteors pouring down around the two of us, tripping over our feet even with such simple movements.

name: Azel
message: 「I'm... about the same」
Azel turned away, looking embarrassed.

name: Azel
message: 「Besides... you and I dancing... is illogical...」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」

name: Azel
message: 「You already know, don't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not illogical. At least not to me」

name: Synn
message: 「Dancing with someone you love makes your heart race and fills you with excitement」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't say things like that!」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you hate me?」
Azel looked down.

name: Azel
message: 「I am not human...」

name: Synn
message: 「I love you, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't say things like that to me!」
Azel raised her face.
She looked like she was about to cry.

name: Azel
message: 「I'm begging you, fight me... fight me!」

name: Synn
message: 「If you really try to destroy the world, Azel, I'll save the world over and over again」

name: Synn
message: 「And tell you that I love you, Azel. I'll say it as many times as it takes」

name: Azel
message: 「Then fight me!」

name: Synn
message: 「But I can't fight you, Azel. Neither can everyone in the Student Council. And you don't want to fight us either」

name: Azel
message: 「That's... not...」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't it?」

name: Azel
message: 「E-Even I... couldn't possibly do it! So come at me from your side!」

name: Synn
message: 「We can't fight when neither of us has the will to」

name: Azel
message: 「Ah... So that's how it is...」

name: Synn
message: 「What is?」

name: Azel
message: 「My Lord... knew everything from the very beginning...」

name: Azel
message: 「My own will... is meaningless after all...」

name: Azel
message: 「Regardless... when the time comes, my--no, the power dwelling within me--will carry out Re-Crea」

name: Azel
message: 「Once a finger is placed on the trigger, the weapon's will is nothing」

name: Synn
message: 「You said that before too, Azel--that you're a weapon. Why?」

name: Azel
message: 「That's...」
Azel's legs tangled with mine.
As Azel stumbled, I instinctively caught her in an embrace.
Her small shoulders gave a slight tremble.

name: Azel
message: 「Ugh... haah, haah...」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry」
Is this what they call a rejection reaction.
I tried to pull away, but Azel wouldn't let go of me.

name: Azel
message: 「Let me... stay like this... a little longer. Until the world ends... No, until this dance is over is enough」
Both Azel's body and voice were trembling.

name: Synn
message: 「Are you in pain?」

name: Azel
message: 「It's... nothing」
Contrary to her words, she looked pained, as if she could barely stay standing without leaning on me.

name: Synn
message: 「Don't force yourself to talk」

name: Azel
message: 「I can tell... A power inside me that isn't mine is swelling... The power of Re-Crea...」

name: Azel
message: 「Soon it will overflow, warp space, and cause the world to collapse...」
A small, warm, trembling body.
It felt as though if I held her too tightly, she might break.

name: Azel
message: 「...It's punishment for my arrogance」

name: Synn
message: 「Arrogance?」

name: Azel
message: 「Ever since long ago... I believed I was special」

name: Azel
message: 「Even in Heaven... I thought my extraordinarily vast vessel of Spirit Power was God's blessing」
Even though she looks to be in so much pain, she keeps taking clumsy steps.

name: Azel
message: 「The day I was chosen for the expedition and descended into this world, I heard the Lord's voice and was granted power」

name: Azel
message: 「I thought it was... proof of that blessing」

name: Azel
message: 「That I was God's proxy, specially created to remake... the world. That I was special because of it」
I sensed Azel give a weak laugh.
Hey. Azel's God.
Why does Azel have to suffer like this?
Even though what she wishes for surely isn't anything grand at all.

name: Azel
message: 「It was... terrible conceit」

name: Azel
message: 「When I realized the power... wouldn't obey my will, I finally understood」

name: Azel
message: 「It wasn't a blessing--I was simply made so I wouldn't break when housing an immense power」

name: Azel
message: 「Thinking I was... chosen was an illusion too. I was made... for that very purpose, so housing it was... only natural」
Like a lost child searching for warmth in the cold rain, Azel pressed her face against my chest and clung to me.
She couldn't stay standing unless she did.

name: Synn
message: 「Stop this already」

name: Azel
message: 「No! Just a little more, just a little longer」
Some terrifying presence began overflowing from Azel's body.
I felt as though the ground had slowly started to shake.

name: Azel
message: 「Everything went... just as the Lord intended」

name: Azel
message: 「Having had Re-Crea thwarted over and over again by the Demon Lord... the Lord intended to neutralize the Demon Lord and those cooperating with him」
Something caught my attention.

name: Azel
message: 「And that was achieved... through me becoming close with you and the others」

name: Azel
message: 「The moment I appeared in this space, you and the others let your last chance to defeat me slip away... We aren't... machines... Even if it's rational... our emotions scream out...」
Azel seemed unable to even stagger through the dance steps anymore, merely clinging to me.

name: Azel
message: 「...I'm sorry... Because you got involved with me... your world is going to be destroyed...」

name: Azel
message: 「But... I can't defy the Lord... I just can't」

name: Azel
message: 「I wish... I never had this power...」
Something warm and wet began soaking through my shirt.
I looked up at the sky just a little.
With the graceful melody of the dance as background music, shooting stars rained down even more heavily,
It wasn't that shooting stars were streaking across the night sky; rather, the night sky was barely peeking through the gaps between the shooting stars.
The world was vast, and beautiful.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「What is it...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Why do you think God would do something like that?」
It wasn't my imagination--the ground had faintly begun to tremble.
It felt like being aboard a massive ship floating on a calm sea.

name: Azel
message: 「The Lord... wants to remake the world no matter what... He hates the Human World, Heaven, and the Demon World alike...」

name: Synn
message: 「No, that's not what I mean. Why would he go about it in such a roundabout way? If he hates them so much, he could just destroy them without question」
That was the part that had caught my attention.
The power of Re-Crea that I saw in front of the church. With that, destroying the world would be easy.
There's no need for it to reside inside Azel.

name: Azel
message: 「Ah... no... so that's it...」

name: Synn
message: 「What is it?」

name: Azel
message: 「That's probably because the Demon Lord was interfering with the Lord's intentions.」

name: Synn
message: 「That doesn't make sense.」
Azel raised her face.
The sparkle of a shooting star shone in her tear-wet eyes.

name: Synn
message: 「If God could do whatever He wanted with everything, He should've been able to do whatever He wanted with the Demon Lord too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」
I felt like there was some important clue here.

name: Azel
message: 「Surely... the Demon Lord is special.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Paqy.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What is it, Lord Demon Lord? And here I was being nice and keeping my mouth shut.」

name: Synn
message: 「How many Demon Lords have there been up until now?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't ask the great me for exact numbers. I ain't got 'em memorized.」

name: Synn
message: 「There were so many you couldn't even remember them all.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, that's how it shakes out.」

name: Synn
message: 「In other words, God lost to all those Demon Lords--so many you couldn't even remember them.」

name: Azel
message: 「That can't be! The Lord must be perfect!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just admit it. That guy is full of holes.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, Paqy. I think God probably is perfect, too. At least, close to perfect.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Huh?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Demon Lord. Weren't you listening to Melilot? There's no point unless we make Azel deny God.」
The shaking of the ground had become like a giant ship--not on a calm day, but on a stormy one.
My feet, dancing slowly, nearly tangled over themselves again and again.

name: Azel
message: 「If I could deny Him, even I would!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then deny Him.」

name: Azel
message: 「But inside me, there is clearly a power that isn't mine... I can tell.」

name: Azel
message: 「Melilot likely tried to think of a way to resolve this crisis without hurting me, yet denying the tangible sensation of my existence is impossible...」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't understand how God thinks. Still, here's what I believe」

name: Synn
message: 「God has always tried to destroy the world in roundabout ways. That's why the Demon Lords and their companions were able to save it」

name: Azel
message: 「Isn't it the same this time...? Surely the Lord learned from past failures...」

name: Synn
message: 「It's roundabout this time, too. Even without dwelling inside you, Azel, wielding that incredible power would make destroying the world easy」

name: Synn
message: 「God hasn't failed at all. Because God is perfect」

name: Synn
message: 「Perfection means never failing. Yet God has failed to realize those intentions. Strange, isn't it?」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't tell me you're claiming failure itself is God's intention!」

name: Synn
message: 「No. Destroying the world probably isn't God's intention at all」

name: Azel
message: 「Then why has the world come to the brink of ruin so many times!」

name: Synn
message: 「Driving the world to the brink of ruin is God's true intention」

name: Azel
message: 「Are you saying the goal isn't to destroy and remake it!」

name: Synn
message: 「More like, if it ends up destroyed, God might as well remake it, I guess?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Then I, to the Lord's will」
A loud crash echoed behind us.
The chairs lined up in the rest area seemed to have toppled over in an avalanche from the tremors.
The world was shaking sickeningly.
Neither vertically nor horizontally, as if the ground beneath our feet were crumbling away.

name: Azel
message: 「Ah」
Holding Azel tightly as she stumbled and nearly fell,

name: Synn
message: 「Are you okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「Yeah... what about you, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm completely fine, though」
Still seated on the ground, we held each other tightly, illuminated by the light of meteors filling the sky.
Is this the end.

name: Azel
message: 「...Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「What? Mmh, mmmmmmm」
It caught me completely off guard.
Something soft and warm pressed against my lips, then pulled away right away.

name: Synn
message: 「W-W-What was that all of a sudden!?」

name: Azel
message: 「Confirming my own feelings」
Azel took a deep breath in my arms and murmured slowly.

name: Azel
message: 「O Lord. I... love this world. The sky, the earth, the people, everything」
Melilot had told me.
That whenever Azel showed a favorable reaction toward this world, a rejection response would wrack her body.
I had seen it countless times myself.

name: Azel
message: 「O Lord. I do not want this world to perish」

name: Azel
message: 「A-And besides... um... I love the man beside me right now more than anyone else」

name: Azel
message: 「That is why I want a future for us!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!」

name: Azel
message: 「W-What are you so surprised about. Y-You are the one who confessed to me! I merely gave you my answer!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm happy, I am, but, um, are you okay!?」

name: Azel
message: 「A-Are you not happy with my answer?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, like I said, I'm happy, but nothing hurts?」
The sickening tremors began to subside.

name: Azel
message: 「It has not hurt for a while now... So... that is what it means」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean? A-Azel」
Along with those words, Azel hugged me tightly.

name: Azel
message: 「The power that was inside me has vanished」

name: Synn
message: 「Does that mean...」
The crisis is over?

name: Azel
message: 「You made me realize it, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「I did?」
